description.value: Latin Fiesta is an authentic Mexican restaurant located in Kelowna's Rutland neighbourhood, celebrated for scratch-made dishes like hand-pressed pupusas, Tacos Dorados, and slow-cooked pozole rojo. Cyclists will find a relaxed, festive atmosphere with an outdoor patio for al fresco dining when weather permits, plus a broad menu with vegetarian and gluten-free options. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, making it a flexible stop for riders at different energy levels.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Latin Fiesta is a real, operating authentic Mexican restaurant at 400B Highway 33 W., Kelowna, BC V1X 1Y1, with phone 778.753.6366. The site explicitly lists Vegetarian Friendly, Gluten Free Options, and Kids Menu, and prominently advertises Take-Out & Delivery alongside Dine-In. No mention anywhere of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging facilities, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM record is missing address, phone, and email fields — all populated from website only.
OSM name 'Latin Fiesta' is a shortened form; full legal name on website is 'Latin Fiesta Mexican Restaurant Ltd.'
